_comment: Models that serve on the vllm engine only with a vllm_torchtpu patch applied at launch. Keyed by Hugging Face model id, matched exactly. `patch` is a file beside this one: a fixed `.patch` diff, or a `.py` patch script that finds its own anchors and so follows the plugin across revisions; `apply_vllm_patch.sh` runs either, and each stack entry may name its own `patch` (defaulting to the model's top-level `patch`). `provenance` is the tpu-knowledge-base keyword holding why it is needed, how to verify the server, and the failures it fixes; `validated` is the stack it was last proven on, `serving` the settings to launch with (they take precedence over the engine check's TP recommendation), and `also_verified` any other settings that passed there; `previously_validated` lists older stacks it was proven on. `image_probe.py` reads this file to select the closest patch version(s) (before and after the installed vllm version, or only the last one on a newer version) and dry-run them against the image's plugin.

validated.also_verified: TP 2 x DP 4 and TP 4 x DP 2 with the same flags; TP 1 has no torch_tpu device layout on this stack

previously_validated.also_verified: the validated serving settings above (TP 8 x DP 1, USE_MOE_SPARSE_CORE=0)
previously_validated.first_validated: 2026-10-01, with gpt_oss_mxfp4.patch (the fixed diff this script replaced) at TP 1 x DP 8
